69601.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of vividha
69601.meaning1: in various ways; in different ways
69601.commentary: (THIa) vividhaṃ panaccakā'ti yantasutt'ādīnaṃ añchanavissajjan'ādinā paṭṭhapitanaccakā, panaccantā viya diṭṭhā'ti yojanā.

examples.text: diṭṭhā hi mayā sucittitā, sombhā dārukapillakāni vā, tantīhi ca khīlakehi ca, vinibaddhā vividhaṃ panaccakā.
kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, satthu pavivittassa viharato sāvakā vivekaṃ n'ānusikkhanti
methunam'anuyuttassa, vighātaṃ brūhi mārisa, sutvāna tava sāsanaṃ, viveke sikkhissāmase.

69604.notes: (MW) the power of separating the invisible Spirit from the visible world (or spirit from matter, truth from untruth, reality from mere semblance or illusion)

examples.text: anusāsa brahme karuṇāyamāno, vivekadhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, yath'āhaṃ ākāso'va abyāpajjamāno, idh'eva santo asito careyyaṃ.
pucchāmi taṃ ādiccabandhu, vivekaṃ santipadañ'ca mahesi, kathaṃ disvā nibbāti bhikkhu, anupādiyāno lokasmiṃ kiñci.
vivekakāmo'si vanaṃ paviṭṭho, atha te mano niccharatī bahiddhā, jano janasmiṃ vinayassu chandaṃ, tato sukhī hohisi vītarāgo.

69606.meaning1: born from seclusion; (or) born from discrimination; (comm) secluded from the defilements
69606.commentary: (NIDD1a) vivekajan'ti ettha vivitti viveko, nīvaraṇavigamo'ti attho. vivitto'ti vā viveko, nīvaraṇavivitto jhānasampayuttadhammarāsī'ti attho. tasmā vivekā, tasmiṃ vā viveke jātan'ti vivekajaṃ.

examples.text: abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ pitu sakkassa kamm'ante sītāya jambucchāyāya nisinno vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharitā.
so imam'eva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati, n'āssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.

69607.meaning1: refined and true perception of joy and happiness born from seclusion
69607.meaning2: refined and true perception of joy and happiness born from seclusion
69607.commentary: (DNa) vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hotī'ti tasmiṃ paṭhamajjhānasamaye vivekajapītisukhasaṅkhātā sukhumasaññā saccā hoti, bhūtā hotī'ti attho. atha vā kāmacchand'ādi-oḷārik'aṅga-ppahānavasena sukhumā ca sā bhūtatāya saccā ca saññā'ti sukhumasacca-saññā, vivekajehi pītisukhehi sampayuttā sukhumasacca-saññā'ti vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā sā assa atthī'ti vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'ti evam'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo. esa nayo sabbattha.
69607.sanskrit: vivekaja + prīti + sukha + sūkṣma + satya + saṃjñā

examples.text: tassa yā purimā kāmasaññā, sā nirujjhati. vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, vivekajapītisukhasukhuma-saccasaññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

69608.meaning1: with a refined and true perception of joy and happiness born from seclusion
69608.meaning2: with a refined and true perception of joy and happiness born from seclusion
69608.commentary: (DNa) vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hotī'ti tasmiṃ paṭhamajjhānasamaye vivekajapītisukhasaṅkhātā sukhumasaññā saccā hoti, bhūtā hotī'ti attho. atha vā kāmacchand'ādi-oḷārik'aṅga-ppahānavasena sukhumā ca sā bhūtatāya saccā ca saññā'ti sukhumasacca-saññā, vivekajehi pītisukhehi sampayuttā sukhumasacca-saññā'ti vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā sā assa atthī'ti vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'ti evam'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo. esa nayo sabbattha.
69608.sanskrit: vivekaja + prīti + sukha + sūkṣma + satya + saṃjñin

examples.text: tassa yā purimā kāmasaññā, sā nirujjhati. vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhuma-saccasaññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

69609.meaning1: bound by gratification to the joy and happiness born from seclusion

examples.text: tassa vivekajapītisukh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti vivekaja-pītisukh'assāda-gadhitaṃ vivekaja-pītisukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ vivekaja-pītisukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

69610.meaning1: bound with a chain to the gratification from the joy and happiness born from seclusion
69610.sanskrit: vivekaja + prīti + sukha + āsvāda + saṃyojana + saṃyukta

examples.text: tassa vivekajapītisukh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti vivekaja-pītisukh'assāda-gadhitaṃ vivekaja-pītisukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ vivekaja-pītisukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

69611.meaning1: bound by the gratification from the joy and happiness produced by seclusion

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. tassa vivekajapītisukh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti vivekaja-pītisukh'assāda-gadhitaṃ vivekaja-pītisukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ vivekaja-pītisukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

69612.meaning1: following the joy and happiness born from seclusion (from the mental obstructions)

examples.text: tassa vivekajapītisukh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti vivekaja-pītisukh'assāda-gadhitaṃ vivekaja-pītisukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ vivekaja-pītisukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

69614.meaning1: established in solitude; (comm) far from defilement

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, khīṇ'āsavassa bhikkhuno vivekaninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāraṃ vivekaṭṭhaṃ nekkhamm'ābhirataṃ byantībhūtaṃ sabbaso āsavaṭṭhāniyehi dhammehi.

69615.commentary: (SNa) taṃ kira sāvatthito dakkhiṇapasse gāvutamatte hoti rājārakkhāya guttaṃ. tattha pavivekakāmā bhikkhū ca bhikkhuniyo ca gacchanti. tasmā ayam'pi kāyavivek'atthinī yena taṃ vanaṃ, ten'upasaṅkami.

examples.text: sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena andhavanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami vivek'atthinī.

69616.meaning1: who sees with discrimination (among); who examines distinctions (in); (comm) seeing Nibbāna

examples.text: nirāsatti anāgate, atītaṃ n'ānusocati, vivekadassī phassesu, diṭṭhīsu ca na nīyati.

69617.meaning1: bent towards solitude; inclined towards solitude

examples.text: saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhitassa kho, gahapati, bhikkhuno vivekaninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāran'ti.

69618.meaning1: based on seclusion; supported by detachment; by means of disengagement
69618.commentary: (SNa) vivekanissitan'ti vivekaṃ nissitaṃ, viveke vā nissitan'ti vivekanissitaṃ.

examples.text: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca, bhikkhave, satta bojjh'aṅgā kathaṃ bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiṃ paripūrenti ? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhitassa kho, gahapati, bhikkhuno vivekaninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāran'ti.
saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhitassa kho, gahapati, bhikkhuno vivekaninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāran'ti.

69621.meaning1: connected with solitude; (or) concerned with discrimination; (comm) supported by Nibbāna

69622.commentary: (APAa) vivekam'anubrūhanto'ti janākiṇṇataṃ pahāya janavivekaṃ cittavivekañ'ca anubrūhanto vaḍḍhento bahulīkaronto mahāvanaṃ ajjhogāhi pāvisī'ti attho.

examples.text: araññe rukkhamūlesu, kandarāsu guhāsu ca, vivekam'anubrūhantā, vihaṃsu tapparāyanā

69623.meaning1: fostering seclusion; nurturing solitude; developing detachment; cultivating disengagement

examples.text: kathañ'c'ānanda, antevās'ūpaddavo hoti? tass'eva kho pan'ānanda, satthu sāvako tassa satthu vivekam'anubrūhayamāno vivittaṃ sen'āsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, satthu pavivittassa viharato sāvakā vivekaṃ n'ānusikkhanti, kittāvatā ca pana satthu pavivittassa viharato sāvakā vivekam'anusikkhantī'ti?

69625.meaning1: delight in solitude; love for seclusion

examples.text: vivekavatto ca so bhavaṃ gotamo antaraghare nisinno hoti.

sacc'āhaṃ, bhante, evaṃdiṭṭhiko ahosiṃ, iti'pi n'atthi paro loko, n'atthi sattā opapātikā, n'atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko'ti. api c'āhaṃ ayyena kumārakassapena etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecito'ti.
app'eva nāma mayaṃ kadāci karahaci tena bhotā gotamena saddhiṃ samāgaccheyyāma, app'eva nāma siyā koci'd'eva kathāsallāpo, app'eva nāma tasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā viveceyyāmā'ti.

69634.meaning1: wanting to separate; wishing to dissuade (from)

examples.text: atha kho te'pi bhikkhū ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetu'kāmā samanuyuñjanti samanugāhanti samanubhāsanti

siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evam'assa, ye no dhammā kusalā kusalasaṅkhātā sācariyakānaṃ, tehi vivecetu'kāmo samaṇo gotamo evam'āhā'ti. na kho pan'etaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. kusalā c'eva vo te dhammā hontu kusalasaṅkhātā ca sācariyakānaṃ.
yato kho te bhikkhū n'āsakkhiṃsu ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetuṃ, atha kho te bhikkhū yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu

69636.meaning2: having separated, having discriminated, having criticized

69641.synonym: antalikkha, ākāsa, vihagapatha, vehāyasa, vehāsa, vehāsaya

examples.text: nanu ahaṃ citta tay'āmhi yācito, giribbaje citrachadā vihaṅ'gamā, mahindaghosa-tthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

69642.synonym: aṇḍaja, dija, pakkhī, vihaṅga, vihaṅgama, sakuṇa

examples.text: yadā nabhe gajjati meghadundubhi, dhār'ākulā vihagapathe samantato, bhikkhū ca pabbhāragato'va jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.

69644.synonym: aṇḍaja, dija, pakkhī, vihaga, vihaṅga, sakuṇa

examples.text: nanu ahaṃ citta tay'āmhi yācito, giribbaje citrachadā vihaṅ'gamā, mahindaghosa-tthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.
sunīlagīvā susikhā supekhunā, sucittapattacchadanā vihaṅ'gamā, sumañjughosa-tthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

69645.grammar: pr, pass of vihanati, intrans (+instr or +loc)

examples.text: puttā m'atthi dhanam'm'atthi, iti bālo vihaññati, attā hi attano n'atthi, kuto puttā kuto dhanaṃ.
chasu loko samuppanno, chasu kubbati santhavaṃ, channam'eva upādāya, chasu loko vihaññatī'ti.

69646.grammar: pr, pass of vihanati, intrans (+instr or +loc)
69646.meaning1: is troubled (by); is worried (about); is afflicted (by)

examples.text: vihaññati kho ayaṃ soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo sakena cittena. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyyan'ti
idha socati pecca socati, pāpakārī ubhay'attha socati, so socati so vihaññati, disvā kammakiliṭṭham'attano.

69647.grammar: prp of vihaññati, pass, intrans (+instr or +loc)
69647.meaning1: suffering hardship (from); being annoyed (by); being irritated (by); being upset (by)

examples.text: disvāna rūpesu vihaññamāne, ruppanti rūpesu janā pamattā, tasmā tuvaṃ piṅgiya appamatto, jahassu rūpaṃ apunabbhavāya.
sukhino vata ye akiñcanā, vedaguno hi janā akiñcanā, sakiñcanaṃ passa vihaññamānaṃ, jano janasmiṃ paṭibandhacitto.
avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno
sabbaṃ niruttipathapāragataṃ sabuddhaṃ, buddhaṃ tilokatilakaṃ hatapāpadhammaṃ, dhammaṃ vimuttisukhadaṃ vihata-agha-saṃghaṃ, saṃghaṃ ca niccam'abhivandiya dakkhiṇeyyaṃ.

69651.commentary: (DNa) vihatena kappāsenā'ti supothitena kappāsena. kāsikavatthañ'hi sukhumattā telaṃ na gaṇhāti, kappāso pana gaṇhāti. tasmā vihatena kappāsenā'ti āha. (DNt) vihatenā'ti kappāsa-vihanana-dhanunā pabbajaṭānaṃ vijaṭanavasena hatena. ten'āha supothitenā'ti, asaṅkaraṇa-vasena suṭṭhu pothitenā'ti attho, dassanīya-saṃvejanīyaṭṭhāna-kittanena ca vasanaṭṭhānaṃ kathitaṃ.

examples.text: rañño, ānanda, cakkavattissa sarīraṃ ahatena vatthena veṭhenti, ahatena vatthena veṭhetvā vihatena kappāsena veṭhenti, vihatena kappāsena veṭhetvā ahatena vatthena veṭhenti.

69654.meaning1: who has repelled annoyance; who has beaten back irritation

69655.meaning1: removes; eliminates; destroys; puts an end (to)
69655.meaning2: kills, puts an end to, removes
69655.commentary: (NIDD1) vihane tamaṃ so'ti rāgatamaṃ dosatamaṃ mohatamaṃ diṭṭhitamaṃ mānatamaṃ kilesatamaṃ duccaritatamaṃ andhakaraṇaṃ acakkhukaraṇaṃ aññāṇakaraṇaṃ paññānirodhikaṃ vighātapakkhikaṃ anibbānasaṃvattanikaṃ haneyya vihaneyya pajaheyya vinodeyya byantiṃ kareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyya. (ITIa) vihane tamaṃ so'ti so evaṃbhūto ariyasāvako arahattamaggena avijjātamaṃ anavasesato vihaneyya samucchindeyya.

examples.text: pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā dhammassavane. katame pañca? assutaṃ suṇāti, sutaṃ pariyodāpeti, kaṅkhaṃ vihanati, diṭṭhiṃ ujuṃ karoti, cittam'assa pasīdati.
etesu dhammesu vineyya chandaṃ, bhikkhu satimā suvimuttacitto, kālena so sammā dhammaṃ parivīmaṃsamāno, ekodibhūto vihane tamaṃ so'ti.

69656.meaning2: killed, put an end to, removed

69657.meaning2: having killed, having put an end to, having removed

examples.text: na dīgham'āyuṃ labhate dhanena, na c'āpi vittena jaraṃ vihanti, appaṃ h'idaṃ jīvitam'āhu dhīrā, asassataṃ vippariṇāmadhammaṃ.

69659.meaning2: having killed, having put an end to, having removed

examples.text: sace te, bhikkhu, agaru viharemu āvesane ekarattan'ti. urundaṃ, āvuso, kumbhakār'āvesanaṃ. viharat'āyasmā yathāsukhan'ti.
evaṃ vutte, aggivessana, āḷāro kālāmo maṃ etadavoca, viharat'āyasmā, tādiso ayaṃ dhammo yattha viññū puriso nacirass'eva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā'ti.
devo ca vassati devo ca gaḷagaḷāyati, ekako c'āhaṃ bherave bile viharāmi, tassa mayhaṃ ekakassa bherave bile viharato, n'atthi bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso vā.
te ce me evaṃ puṭṭhā, āmā'ti paṭijānanti, ty'āhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi, api pana tumhe āyasmanto ek'antasukhaṃ lokaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharathā'ti? iti puṭṭhā, no'ti vadanti.

69662.commentary: (ITIa) upasampajja viharatī'ti pāpuṇitvā sampādetvā viharati. (PMa) upasampajja viharatī'ti taṃ patvā nipphādetvā tadanurūpena iriyāpathena viharati.

examples.text: yattha kāmā nirujjhanti, ye ca kāme nirodhetvā nirodhetvā viharanti, addhā te āyasmanto nicchātā nibbutā tiṇṇā pāraṅ'gatā tadaṅgenā'ti vadāmi
ye kho pana me, pañcasikha, sāvakā sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājānanti, te āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti

69663.synonym: ajjhāvasanta, dharamāna, paṭivasanta, paribbasāna, vasanta, vasamāna, viharamāna

examples.text: so tathā vūpakaṭṭho viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ anussarati anuvitakketi.
yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, cakkhu'ndriyasaṃvaraṃ asaṃvutassa viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, cakkhu'ndriyasaṃvaraṃ saṃvutassa viharato evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti
sabbe saddhammagaruno, vihaṃsu viharanti ca, tathā'pi viharissanti, esā buddhāna dhammatā.
accāraddhamhi vīriyamhi, satthā loke anuttaro, vīṇ'opamaṃ karitvā me, dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā, tass'āhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, vihāsiṃ sāsane rato.
vihari apekkhaṃ idha vā huraṃ vā, yo vedagū samito yat'atto, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalitto, lokassa jaññā udayabbayañ'cā'ti.

69668.grammar: masc, agent, from viharati, irreg, intrans
69668.notes: agent noun used verbally see Perniola §292

examples.text: abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ pitu sakkassa kamm'ante sītāya jambucchāyāya nisinno vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharitā.
eko'va bhagavā tasmiṃ samaye viharitu'kāmo hoti na bhagavā tasmiṃ samaye kenaci anubandhitabbo hotī'ti

69670.meaning1: to live; to stay; to remain

examples.text: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo sammāsamādhiṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.
so na sakkoti vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.

69671.meaning2: having lived, having abode, having dwelled, having sojourned

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhoganagare yath'ābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, āyām'ānanda, yena pāvā ten'upasaṅkamissāmā'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
atha khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, uruvelāyaṃ yath'ābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena bārāṇasī tena cārikaṃ pakkamiṃ.
sabbe saddhammagaruno, vihaṃsu viharanti ca. athā'pi viharissanti, esā buddhāna dhammatā.

69673.grammar: opt, reflx 1st pl of vihareyya, intrans (+loc)
69673.meaning1: we may live; we could stay (in)
69673.commentary: (THIa) yadi viharemase kānan'antare'ti yadi mayaṃ ubho'pi van'antare saha vasāma ramāma.

examples.text: ahaṃ tava vas'ānugo siyaṃ, yadi viharemase kānan'antare, na hi m'atthi tayā piyattaro, pāṇo kinnarimandalocane.

69674.meaning1: we may live; we could stay (in)

examples.text: sace te, bhaggava, agaru viharemu āvesane ekarattan'ti. na kho me, bhante, garu. atthi c'ettha pabbajito paṭhamaṃ vās'ūpagato. sace so anujānāti, viharatha, bhante, yathāsukhan'ti.
sace te kassapa agaru, viharemu ajjaṇho aggisālamhī'ti
kadā nu'haṃ pabbatakandarāsu, ekākiyo addutiyo vihassaṃ, aniccato sabbabhavaṃ vipassaṃ, taṃ me idaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
yo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye, appamatto vihassati, pahāya jātisaṃsāraṃ, dukkhass'antaṃ karissati.

69678.grammar: fut, reflx 1st sg of vihassati, intrans

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ pabbatakandarāsu, ekākiyo addutiyo vihassaṃ, aniccato sabbabhavaṃ vipassaṃ, taṃ me idaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
kadā nu'haṃ bhinnapaṭan'dharo muni, kāsāvavattho amamo nirāso, rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca tath'eva mohaṃ, hantvā sukhī pavanagato vihassaṃ.

69679.grammar: aor 3rd pl of vihari, irreg conjugation, intrans

examples.text: sabbe saddhammagaruno, vihaṃsu viharanti ca, tathā'pi viharissanti, esā buddhāna dhammatā.
araññe rukkhamūlesu, kandarāsu guhāsu ca, vivekam'anubrūhantā, vihaṃsu tapparāyanā

69680.meaning1: should be lived; should be continued (with)

examples.text: sace pan'āvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti, na kho'mhi pāp'iccho, na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato'ti, ten'āvuso, bhikkhunā ten'eva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahoratt'ānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
n'atthi me pāpakā akusalā dhammā appahīnā ye me assu rattiṃ kālaṃ karontassa antarāyāyā'ti, tena bhikkhunā ten'eva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahoratt'ānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.

69681.commentary: (ANa) ekissā vā tiṇ'odakadattiyā vimānito'ti ekadivasaṃ ekena tiṇ'odakadānena vimānito, ekadivasamattaṃ aladdhatiṇ'odako'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato ekissā vā tiṇ'odakadattiyā vihānito dvīhi vā tīhi vā catūhi vā pañcahi vā tiṇ'odakadattīhi vihānito saṃsīdati visīdati, na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rasānaṃ.

69682.meaning2: having abandoned, having forsaken, having left, having given up

examples.text: saddhā dutiyā purisassa hoti, no ce assaddhiyaṃ avatiṭṭhati, yaso ca kittī ca tatv'assa hoti, saggañ'ca so gacchati sarīraṃ vihāyā'ti.
yo ca sītañ'ca uṇhañ'ca, tiṇā bhiyyo na maññati, karaṃ purisakiccāni, so sukhā na vihāyati.

69684.commentary: (ANa) sabbakammavihāyīnan'ti sabbaṃ tebhūmakakammaṃ cajitvā paricchinnaṃ parivaṭumaṃ katvā ṭhitaṃ.

examples.text: sabbakammavihāyīnaṃ, panuṇṇaṃ ko nivāraye, nekkhaṃ jambonadass'eva, ko taṃ ninditum'arahati, devā'pi naṃ pasaṃsanti, brahmunā'pi pasaṃsito'ti.
atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo yena so vihāro saṃvutadvāro, tena appasaddo upasaṅkamitvā ataramāno ālindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi.

atha kho bhagavā bahu'd'eva rattiṃ abbhokāse nisajjāya vītināmetvā pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pāvisi. āyasmā'pi kho soṇo bahu'd'eva rattiṃ abbhokāse nisajjāya vītināmetvā pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pāvisi.

tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno āyasmā ca ānando avāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihāre āhiṇḍanti, abhikkamath'āyasmanto, abhikkamath'āyasmanto! idān'āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato sammukhā sīhanādaṃ nadissatī'ti.
ekasmiñ'hi kāle satthari āḷavinagaraṃ upanissāya agg'āḷave cetiye viharante bahū upāsakā upāsikā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ca vihāraṃ dhammassavan'atthāya gacchanti, divā dhammassavanaṃ hoti.

69687.meaning1: mode of living; way of life; way to spend time; mode of existence
69687.meaning2: mode of life, passing the time

examples.text: iti purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāma navañ'ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāma yātrā ca no bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsu vihāro cā'ti
ayam'pi kho, bhikkhave, ān'āpānassatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato santo c'eva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppann'uppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.

69688.meaning2: mode of life, passing the time

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho mayaṃ āyasmato anuruddhassa evam'ārocimha, imāsañ'ca imāsañ'ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ mayaṃ lābhino'ti
atha kho bhagavā tassa aḍḍhamāsassa accayena paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi, yena sv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, vihārena paṭham'ābhisambuddho viharāmi, tassa padesena vihāsiṃ.

69689.meaning1: who is building a monastery; who is having a building constructed

examples.text: tena vihārakārakena bhikkhunā vihāravatthuṃ sodhetvā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam'assa vacanīyo

69690.meaning1: rule about building a monastery; Saṅghādisesa 7

69692.commentary: (VINa) vihāracīvaraṃ nāma manussā āvāsaṃ kāretvā, cattāro'pi paccayā amhākaṃ'y'eva santakā paribhogaṃ gacchantū'ti ticīvaraṃ sajjetvā attanā kārāpite āvāse ṭhapenti, etaṃ vihāracīvaraṃ nāma.

69693.commentary: (VIN) vihāraṭṭhaṃ nāma bhaṇḍaṃ vihāre catūhi ṭhānehi nikkhittaṃ hoti, bhūmaṭṭhaṃ, thalaṭṭhaṃ, ākāsaṭṭhaṃ, vehāsaṭṭhaṃ.

examples.text: vihāraṭṭhaṃ nāma bhaṇḍaṃ vihāre catūhi ṭhānehi nikkhittaṃ hoti, bhūmaṭṭhaṃ, thalaṭṭhaṃ, ākāsaṭṭhaṃ, vehāsaṭṭhaṃ.

atthi pana, bho gotama, añño yañño imāya ca tividhāya yaññasampadāya soḷasaparikkhārāya iminā ca niccadānena anukulayaññena iminā ca vihāradānena app'aṭṭhataro ca appasamārambhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mah'ānisaṃsataro cā'ti?

69695.commentary: (DNa) vihārapacchāyāyan'ti vihārachāyāyaṃ, kūṭ'āgāramahāgehacchāyāya pharit'okāse'ti attho. sā kira kūṭ'āgārasālā dakkhiṇ'uttarato dīghā pācīnamukhā, ten'assā purato mahatī chāyā patthaṭā hoti, sīho tattha bhagavato āsanaṃ paññapesi.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā vihārā nikkhamitvā vihārapacchāchāyāyaṃ paññatte āsane nisīdi.

69696.commentary: (DNa) vihārapacchāyāyan'ti vihārachāyāyaṃ, kūṭ'āgāramahāgehacchāyāya pharit'okāse'ti attho. sā kira kūṭ'āgārasālā dakkhiṇ'uttarato dīghā pācīnamukhā, ten'assā purato mahatī chāyā patthaṭā hoti, sīho tattha bhagavato āsanaṃ paññapesi.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā vihārā nikkhamitvā vihārapacchāyāyaṃ paññatte āsane nisīdi.

69698.meaning1: looking after the monastery; taking care of the monastery
69698.commentary: (SNa) vihārapālo'ti so kira tadā avassiko hoti pattacīvaraggahaṇe akovido. atha naṃ therā bhikkhū, āvuso, imāni chatt'upāhana-kattarayaṭṭhi-ādīni olokento nisīdā'ti vihārarakkhakaṃ katvā piṇḍāya pavisiṃsu. tena vuttaṃ, vihārapālo'ti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭho hoti. āyasmā udāyī ohiyyako hoti vihārapālo.
tena kho pana samayena āyasmā vaṅg'īso navako hoti acirapabbajito ohiyyako vihārapālo.

69699.meaning1: inspecting the monastery; taking a look at the monastery

examples.text: atha kho sambahulā itthiyo samalaṅkaritvā yena agg'āḷavako ārāmo ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu vihārapekkhikāyo. atha kho āyasmato vaṅg'īsassa tā itthiyo disvā anabhirati uppajjati, rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
